source.label: Public X graph research

metricDefinitions.label: Relationship events
metricDefinitions.definition: Each person-to-person event is one author–recipient relation supported by an original post. One post can credit several recipients.

caveats: The complete graph contains one unverified company affiliation. The reviewed graph excludes it.
Six worked-with edges reuse endorsement evidence; they are not additional vouches.
Two organization profile images remain unresolved. Image URLs were observed, not downloaded.

evidenceFlow.title: Discovery and source review
evidenceFlow.detail: Grok supplied two discovery batches. All 27 original posts behind the 33 person-to-person events were independently read in X.

evidenceFlow.title: Graph integrity
evidenceFlow.detail: The build checked unique node/edge IDs, duplicate person–post relations, edge endpoint integrity, and source references. All checks passed.
